name: Citadines Connect Cecil Georgetown Penang
detail: A great little hotel with a strategic location, although it’s slightly on the outskirts of Georgetown. The rooms and overall space are compact, but everything is thoughtfully designed, modern, and well-equipped with complete facilities. Perfect for travelers who appreciate comfort, convenience, and modern amenities without needing a huge hotel room. Definitely a great stay in Penang!

name: Jazz Hotel Penang
detail: This was my first time booking at this hotel and my experience was very satisfying. The hotel staff were very friendly and provided excellent service to all guests, even those who were not VIPs. The room was comfortable, clean, and spacious. Although my room did not have an iron, I just had to call the hotel number to request one, and they sent an iron to my room right away. It was very convenient. For Muslim guests, there is a suitable space for prayers and a qibla direction marker on the ceiling. Parking inside the building is also easy and very convenient. The only slight improvement that could be made is regarding the Wi-Fi. Perhaps due to many guests using the Wi-Fi at the same time, the speed was somewhat slow. I hope the hotel can further enhance the quality and speed of the Wi-Fi in the future. I hope the hotel can continue to maintain the cleanliness of the rooms and the quality of service as it is now. Highly recommended and I will definitely come again!

name: Collection O Batu Ferringhi Beach formerly ESQ Ferringhi
detail: Cozy beds, spacious room, and awesome staff. We laughed through every photo attempt!

name: Some Place Else
detail: This is the most comfortable youth hostel I have stayed at during my travels to many countries! The staff speaks multiple languages and is especially welcoming to Chinese tourists. The bathrooms and common areas are kept very clean, the shared space is spacious, and there are movies to watch in the evening along with various activities; the atmosphere is great. This is my second time staying here, as I visited in 2025. I will also recommend this hostel on domestic social media. I hope to choose to stay here every year when I come to Penang, wishing the owner great business success!

name: Areca Hotel Penang
detail: Conveniently located in Georgetown, this hotel has a very nice atmosphere. The front desk and restaurant staff all greet you with smiles and provide a pleasant response. There are only bath towels and bath mats provided. I would have liked at least a hand towel. The shower comes with a single bottle of shampoo and body soap combined (which is all-in-one), and it was my first experience with this. I used soap from another hotel that I had in my suitcase. (There is soap placed at the wash basin.) The breakfast has a sufficient variety, and there is also a simple afternoon tea service. The free shuttle bus stop and bus terminal are also relatively close, making it a convenient location to move around. However, it was disappointing that the safe was not secured. I was unable to use it. I hope for improvements in this area.

name: lyf Georgetown Penang
detail: It is conveniently located for both dining and sightseeing, and the hotel is clean and quiet. The staff is friendly. There is a 24-hour nasi kandar within walking distance, and you can get there almost without getting wet even if it rains. The bakery at the back also has a nice atmosphere. The traffic on the roads around the hotel is heavy, so be cautious if you have small children. Overall, I will definitely return.

name: SAVV Hotel
detail: The location is good. It's facing the main road on Penang Road, which means the sidewalk is poor and difficult to walk, but it's easy to call a Grab, and it's close to Armenian Street and Chulia Street, making it convenient for sightseeing. Chew Jetty is just across the street, so you can drop by easily. It's also great that myNEWS (convenience store) is very close, and it's an option to take out food from the food court. I was attracted to book it because the cabin's photos showed a full ocean view, but the cabin is on the second floor (Japanese style), so what you actually get is the lower half being a gas station across the road and the ocean being the upper half. I could see boats coming and going, which personally satisfied me. The hallway on my reserved floor had a red carpet, giving it a luxurious feel. Overall, the design is beautiful. Regarding cleanliness, I was not worried about bugs, and the pillows were not firm. I was a bit concerned about the lack of exhaust fans in the bathroom, but it seemed to be the same everywhere, so it doesn't seem to be a hotel-specific issue. Above all, the service from the staff was excellent, and since I don't speak English well, they patiently explained things even when I asked them to repeat. There are also a few staff members who can speak a little Japanese. The security staff is cheerful as well. Arriving early in the morning in Penang and being able to leave my luggage right away and head out for sightseeing on foot was great. Overall, I felt it was a good hotel that was free from any cheapness, yet still had a sense of warmth.

name: Carnarvon 73
detail: A very pleasant and memorable stay! The location is great, with many interesting places nearby. The staff were very helpful with the check-in and check-out process, even though everything was self-service. I arrived early, and the staff kindly allowed me to early check in. I really loved the interior design of both the building and the room. Everything was very aesthetic while still being functional. The room was spacious for a single room, with plenty of space to move around comfortably and all the facilities I needed. Although the bathrooms are shared, they were always clean and well-maintained. And one small detail that I really appreciated—the towels smelled so nice! Overall, I really enjoyed my stay here. The combination of the location, beautiful design, cleanliness, and thoughtful details made the experience even better. I would definitely love to stay here again!

name: St. Giles Wembley Penang
detail: I arrived early and intended to wait until check-in time to handle my luggage, but they checked me in early. (The staff was very friendly) The hotel seems to be older, but the room, bathroom, and towels are all clean, and the entire hotel feels well-maintained. The hotel I stayed at in Kuala Lumpur was very disappointing in terms of cleanliness, towels, and breakfast, but this place is really satisfying for the price. There is a good variety for breakfast as well. I experienced constipation during my trip, but I appreciated having greens available. The location is also close to the mural street, which is great. This is my third accommodation in Malaysia during my ten-day stay, and this place is my favorite. The only downside is that there's a forced alarm from a nearby mosque in the early morning.

name: Carnarvon House
detail: The hotel options in Penang are really numerous, ranging from hostels to world heritage hotels. For us, during the hotel selection process, I hoped to book a hotel with a good geographical location, reasonable prices, and especially one with local characteristics. Thus, Kim Hotel naturally became our choice. Before booking, I noticed that the reserved room type did not have a private bathroom, which made me a bit worried. However, upon arriving at the hotel and seeing the bathroom and shower room, the cleanliness here completely dispelled my earlier concerns, even cleaner than my home bathroom at times, haha. The host warmly welcomed us and informed us that although the hotel does not provide breakfast, there are free snacks, coffee, and tea. Oh, and there's also a self-service water dispenser next to our room, providing hot and cold water. The room we stayed in is small, but very clean. There are many delicious restaurants worth visiting next to the hotel. I really recommend it and will choose to stay at Kim Hotel again next time.
